channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Alone in the Dark
item.description: Return to Derceto Manor in this reimagination of Alone in the Dark, a love letter to the 90’s cult classic horror game.

item.title: Darksiders Genesis
item.description: DARKSIDERS: GENESIS gives players their first look at the world of DARKSIDERS before the events of the original game. Furthermore, it introduces the fourth and last horseman STRIFE, as well as Co-op gameplay for the first time in the history of the franchise.

item.title: Dusk City
item.description: A flourishing civilization had sunk into the sea. The night never dawns...... and a sense of apocalypse hangs over the world. You'll land on an island in such a world, and as you explore the town and ruins, you'll come into contact with fragments of the world's mysteries.

item.title: Gothic 1
item.description: War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed...

item.title: Kingdoms and Castles
item.description: Kingdoms and Castles is a city-building simulation game about growing a kingdom from a tiny hamlet to a sprawling city and imposing castle. Make trade agreements, alliance, and war with neighboring AI controlled kingdoms. Each villager and resource is individually simulated.

item.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
item.description: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

item.title: Strange Brigade
item.description: Embark on an exotic journey into danger in this rip-roaring 1930s third person adventure for 1-4 players! Encounter pulse-pounding action, treacherous traps and tales of derring-do!

item.title: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition Director's Cut
item.description: Become The Witcher, Geralt of Rivia, a legendary monster slayer caught in a web of intrigue woven by forces vying for control of the world. Make difficult decisions and live with the consequences in a game that will immerse you in an extraordinary tale like no other.

item.title: Alice: Madness Returns
item.description: Alice: Madness Returns is a third-person, single-player, action adventure platformer. Visit the grim reality of Victorian London and travel to the beautiful yet ghastly Wonderland to uncover the root of Alice's madness.

item.title: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
item.description: Survive your evolution in Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago. Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in the exciting new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

item.title: Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition
item.description: Experience what it’s like to be Batman and face off against Gotham's greatest villians. Explore every inch of Arkham Asylum and roam freely on the infamous island.

item.title: Battlefield 3™
item.description: Enjoy total freedom to fight the way you want. Explore 29 massive multiplayer maps and use loads of vehicles, weapons, and gadgets to help you turn up the heat. Every second of battle gets you closer to unlocking tons of extras and moving up in the Ranks. So get in the action.

item.title: Battlefield 4™
item.description: Embrace unrivaled destruction in Battlefield 4™. Revel in the glorious chaos of all-out war packed with rewarding, tactical challenges in an interactive environment.

item.title: CarX Drift Racing Online - Season Pass
item.description: Get access to all released and upcoming CarX Drift Racing Online DLCs with the Season Pass!

item.title: Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator
item.description: Build rigs to mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and other cryptocurrency. Trade on the market to grow wealth. Expand your business into new offices. Hire skilled employees and assign tasks. Use cash from your mega farms to research new technologies and reach the goal of each scenario.

item.title: Darksiders III
item.description: Return to an apocalyptic Earth in Darksiders III, a hack-n-slash Action Adventure where players assume the role of FURY in her quest to hunt down and dispose of the Seven Deadly Sins. The most enigmatic of the Four Horsemen, FURY must bring balance to the forces that now ravage Earth.

item.title: DayZ Frostline
item.description: Embark on an unforgiving journey in DayZ's Frostline Expansion, set within the icy Sakhal archipelago, covering 83km² of winter wilderness. Face new challenges, manage the cold, and discover the beauty and peril of Sakhal. Prepare to survive.

item.title: Dead Space (2008)
item.description: You are Isaac Clarke, an engineer on the spacecraft USG Ishimura. You're not a warrior. You're not a soldier. You are, however, the last line of defense for the remaining living crew.

item.title: Destroy All Humans!
item.description: The cult-classic returns! Terrorize the people of 1950's Earth in the role of the evil alien Crypto-137. Harvest their DNA and bring down the US government in the faithful remake of the legendary alien invasion action adventure. Annihilate puny humans using an assortment of alien weaponry and psychic abilities.

item.title: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
item.description: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

item.title: Kerbal Space Program: Making History Expansion
item.description: Expand your Kerbal experience like never before with Kerbal Space Program: Making History Expansion. The first expansion pack for the critically acclaimed space simulation game adds new content to Kerbal Space Program, including an immersive Mission Builder, a History Pack featuring missions inspired by historical events, and a wealth of...

item.title: Mirror's Edge™
item.description: In a city where information is heavily monitored, couriers called Runners transport sensitive data. In this seemingly utopian paradise, a crime has been committed, & you are being hunted. You are a Runner called Faith and this innovative first-person action-adventure is your story.

item.title: Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered
item.description: Feel the thrill of the chase and the rush of escape behind the wheels of the world’s hottest high-performance cars in Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered– a heart-pumping, socially competitive racing experience.

item.title: Need for Speed™ Most Wanted
item.description: The open-world action in Need for Speed Most Wanted gives you the freedom to drive your way. Hit jumps and shortcuts, switch cars, lie low or head for terrain that plays to your vehicle’s unique strengths. Fight your way past cops and rivals using skill, high-end car tech and tons of nitrous.

item.title: Road 96 🛣️
item.description: Hitchhike your way to freedom in this crazy procedurally generated road trip. No one's road is the same!

item.title: Slackers - Carts of Glory
item.description: Step into the wonderful world of Slackers! Picture this: you and your friends run out of drinks and the store is closing! Hop in a shopping cart, the ultimate eco-friendly marvel, master the art of riding an unpredictable beast, discover shortcuts as you pave your path to glory!

item.title: Sniper Elite 3
item.description: Sniper Elite 3 is a tactical third-person shooter that combines stealth, gameplay choice and genre-defining ballistics with huge, open levels and the exotic terrain of World War 2 North Africa.

item.title: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
item.description: In the dark days of the end of World War 2 amidst the ruins of Berlin, one bullet can change history… Elite sniper Karl Fairburne returns to the front line in the remaster of this award-winning stealth-action experience. Packed with new features, contemporary visuals and definitive content.

item.title: Sonic Adventure DX
item.description: An ancient evil lurking within the Master Emerald has been unleashed from its slumber by the devious Dr. Eggman and is on the verge of becoming the ultimate monster using the 7 Chaos Emeralds. Only Sonic and his friends are heroic enough to put a stop to Dr. Eggman and his evil minions.

item.title: Sonic Forces
item.description: The fate of Sonic the Hedgehog’s world is in your hands – Join the Uprising.

item.title: Sonic Lost World
item.description: When the Deadly Six threaten to destroy his world, Sonic’s new moves & power-ups are the only way to defeat them before it’s too late!

item.title: STAR WARS™: Squadrons
item.description: Master the art of starfighter combat in the authentic piloting experience STAR WARS™: Squadrons. Feel the adrenaline of first-person multiplayer space dogfights alongside your squadron, and buckle up in a thrilling STAR WARS™ story.

item.title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League
item.description: From the creators of Batman: Arkham, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is a genre-defying third-person action shooter where the ultimate band of misfits must do the impossible: Kill the Justice League.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Cottage Living Expansion Pack
item.description: Delight in the quaint charm of The Sims™ 4 Cottage Living Expansion Pack with animal friends, garden-to-table meals, and a close-knit community.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Discover University
item.description: Hit the books and show your school spirit, where Sims enroll in school, explore collegiate experiences, and enjoy extracurricular activities.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Get To Work
item.description: Become a daring doctor, fearless detective, mad scientist, or create your own retail business and become a Simoleonaire with The Sims 4 Get to Work.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Get Together
item.description: Create Clubs for your Sims where you set the rules, define their looks, and customize their hangouts in The Sims™ 4 Get Together.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Horse Ranch Expansion Pack
item.description: Work hard and play hard with animal friends and your own stretch of land in The Sims™ 4 Horse Ranch Expansion Pack.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Island Living
item.description: Escape the ordinary and enjoy a laid-back lifestyle surrounded by beaches in The Sims 4 Island Living. Explore a breezy world drenched in sun, sand, and endless fun as your Sims make their own paradise.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Life & Death Expansion Pack
item.description: Peel back the veil to uncover the secret to fuller Sim lives and beyond in The Sims™ 4 Life & Death Expansion Pack*.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Lovestruck Expansion Pack
item.description: Meet your match.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - ATV SABER 4X4
item.description: The wardens recently met at a conference for wildlife management, and realized how they have all noticed a buildup of visitors at the entry points of their respective hunting reserves. To encourage full exploration of the reserves, the wardens have approved the use of All Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) within them – but strictly as a mode of...

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Bloodhound
item.description: Adopt a clever new approach to hunting with the Bloodhound by your side. This canine-companion has an incredible sense of smell, tracking scents over large distances.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Emerald Coast Australia
item.description: Welcome to Australia! Discover breathtaking landscapes and hunt iconic animal species such as the Saltwater Crocodile and Eastern Gray Kangaroo as you explore this magical new hunting destination down under.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Modern Rifle Pack
item.description: Expand your weapon arsenal with a brand new collection of modern rifles! This pack includes the ZARZA-15 .22LR, ZARZA-15 .223, and ZARZA-10 .308.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Tents & Ground Blinds
item.description: The reserve wardens Conni and Doc have received a new shipment of equipment and thanks to Robert Sommer’s connections, they were able to get their hands on a tent and a ground blind. These new items will make your hunting experience in both Hirschfelden and Layton Lake District even more complete.

item.title: Unravel Two
item.description: When you cut ties to the past, new bonds form. Build relationships with other Yarnys in local co-op or as a single player, fostering friendship and support as you journey together.

item.title: A Way Out
item.description: A Way Out is an exclusively co-op adventure where you play the role of one of two prisoners making their daring escape from prison.

item.title: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
item.description: You are the Monarch. Choose between diplomacy and tyranny. Romance allies or enemies. Your decisions define your rule and the fate of those closest to you in this character-driven interactive tale.

item.title: Arma 3
item.description: Experience true combat gameplay in a massive military sandbox. Deploy with a wide variety of single- and multiplayer content, a massive arsenal of modern weapons and vehicles, and limitless opportunities for content creation. Authentic, diverse, open - Arma 3 sends you to war.

item.title: Arma Reforger
item.description: Engage in massive combined arms battles, create and curate combat missions in real time, and shape your experience with endless community mods. Deploy into the Cold War and experience the most authentic and immersive military sandbox ever created.

item.title: Atomfall
item.description: A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.

item.title: Atomfall Story Expansion Pack: The Red Strain
item.description: Continue the adventure of Atomfall with "The Red Strain” Story Expansion Pack, introducing a new location, enemies, quests, characters, items, weapons, and more. • Investigate Test Site Moriah • Enhance your Arsenal • Fight for Survival

item.title: Atomfall: Story Expansion Pack Wicked Isle
item.description: The Atomfall story continues with the “Wicked Isle” Story Expansion Pack, introducing a new location, enemies, quests, characters, items, weapons, and maybe even a way to escape. Explore the isle’s mysteries Uncover new treasures Face fearsome foes

item.title: Batman: Arkham City - Game of the Year Edition
item.description: Get Batman: Arkham City and all DLC for one low price with the release of the GOTY Edition!

item.title: Batman™: Arkham Knight
item.description: Batman™: Arkham Knight brings the award-winning Arkham trilogy from Rocksteady Studios to its epic conclusion. Developed exclusively for New-Gen platforms, Batman: Arkham Knight introduces Rocksteady's uniquely designed version of the Batmobile.

item.title: Batman™: Arkham Origins
item.description: As of December 4, 2016, the online services portion of Batman: Arkham Origins has been retired. We thank those that have joined us to battle. The Single player campaign may still be played and enjoyed offline. For any questions relating to Batman: Arkham Origins, please contact WB Games customer service.

item.title: Battlefield™ 1
item.description: Battlefield™ 1 takes you back to The Great War, WW1, where new technology and worldwide conflict changed the face of warfare forever.

item.title: Battlefield™ 2042
item.description: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.

item.title: Battlefield™ V
item.description: This is the ultimate Battlefield V experience. Enter mankind’s greatest conflict with the complete arsenal of weapons, vehicles, and gadgets plus the best customization content of Year 1 and 2.

item.title: CarX Drift Racing Online
item.description: CarX Drift Racing Online is your chance to immerse yourself in the real world of drifting. Get together with friends, tune your car and burn some tires!

item.title: Coral Island
item.description: Coral Island is a vibrant, laid-back farm sim reimagined with multiplayer! Experience enchanting island life at your own pace: farm with friends, nurture animals, build relationships, hang out with a diverse cast of characters, and dive into the magical Merfolk Kingdom.

item.title: Crime Boss: Rockay City
item.description: Crime Boss: Rockay City is a 1-4 player co-op FPS heist game with enjoyable stealth and epic killing spree combat. Featuring a solo roguelike campaign that combines FPS and strategy elements with the most hilariously cheesy voice acting that make you laugh.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077
item.description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
item.description: Phantom Liberty is a new spy-thriller expansion for the open-world action-adventure RPG Cyberpunk 2077. As cyber-enhanced mercenary V, join secret agent Solomon Reed to unravel a web of shattered loyalties and sinister political machinations.

item.title: DayZ
item.description: How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ – this is your story.

item.title: Dead as Disco
item.description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

item.title: Dead Space
item.description: The sci-fi survival-horror classic returns, completely rebuilt to offer an even more immersive experience — including visual, audio, and gameplay improvements — while staying faithful to the original game’s thrilling vision.

item.title: Dead Space™ 2
item.description: Three years after the Necromorph infestation aboard the USS Ishimura, Isaac Clarke awakens from a coma, confused, disoriented, and on a space station called The Sprawl. Explore this world and its zero-g environments to discover the truth about the Unitology and its role in the Necromorph epidemic.

item.title: Dead Space™ 3
item.description: Journey across space to the icy planet of Tau Volantis with Isaac Clarke and Sgt. John Carver to discover and destroy the source of the Necromorph outbreak.

item.title: Destroy All Humans! 2 - Reprobed
item.description: Crypto is back with a license to probe. The alien invader returns, groovier than ever. Experience the swinging ‘60s in all its chemical-induced glory and take revenge on the KGB for blowing up your mothership. You’ll have to form alliances with members of the very species you came to enslave.

item.title: DiRT Rally 2.0
item.description: DiRT Rally 2.0 dares you to carve your way through a selection of iconic rally locations from across the globe, in the most powerful off-road vehicles ever made, knowing that the smallest mistake could end your stage.

item.title: Dragon Age II: Ultimate Edition
item.description: You are Hawke, a refugee seeking to escape the darkspawn-plagued land of Ferelden and become Champion of Kirkwall. Rise to power and fight epic battles while making decisions that determine the course of civilization.

item.title: Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition
item.description: Explore a stunning world, make complex moral choices, and engage in bone-crushing combat against massive and terrifying creatures. The Ultimate Edition includes Dragon Age: Origins, Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening and all nine content packs.

item.title: Dragon Age™ Inquisition
item.description: Winner of over 130 Game of the Year awards, discover the definitive Dragon Age: Inquisition experience. The Game of the Year Edition includes the critically acclaimed game, all three official add-ons - Jaws of Hakkon, The Descent, and Trespasser - and more.

item.title: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard
item.description: Unite the Veilguard and defy the gods in Dragon Age™: The Veilguard, an immersive single-player RPG.

item.title: Everwind
item.description: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

item.title: Evil Genius 2: World Domination
item.description: A satirical spy-fi lair builder where YOU are the criminal mastermind! Construct your base, train your minions, defend your operations from the Forces of Justice, and achieve global domination!

item.title: For The King II
item.description: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of four players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelite tabletop RPG. Will you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret?

item.title: Frosthaven
item.description: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

item.title: Gotham Knights
item.description: Batman is dead. It is now up to the Batman Family - Batgirl, Nightwing, Red Hood, and Robin - to protect Gotham City.

item.title: Human Fall Flat
item.description: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded.

item.title: Hyper Light Drifter
item.description: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

item.title: IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad
item.description: IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad is the continuation of the legendary IL-2 Sturmovik series that has set the standard for PC combat flight games for more than ten years. This new entry into the series will offer virtual pilots an even more accurate simulation of the most famous air battles.

item.title: Injustice™ 2
item.description: Build and power up the ultimate version of your favourite DC legends in INJUSTICE 2. This is your Legend. Your Journey. Your Injustice.

item.title: It Takes Two
item.description: Embark on the craziest journey of your life in It Takes Two. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass and work together across a huge variety of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges. Winner of GAME OF THE YEAR at the Game Awards 2021.

item.title: Jagged Alliance 3
item.description: The country of Grand Chien is thrown into chaos when the elected president goes missing and the paramilitary force known as “the Legion” seizes control. Hire mercs, meet interesting characters, and fight in tactically deep turn-based combat in this true successor to a beloved franchise.

item.title: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando
item.description: Pick a character and team up with three friends ‘cause it’s time to save the world. Experience intense FPS action as you obliterate hordes of terrifying monsters! You may not be on the best team of mercenaries, but you are… a Toxic Commando!

item.title: Kerbal Space Program
item.description: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics.

item.title: Kerbal Space Program: Breaking Ground Expansion
item.description: Kerbal Space Program: Breaking Ground Expansion is the second expansion for the PC version of the critically acclaimed space flight simulator, Kerbal Space Program. This feature-rich expansion is focused on increasing the objective possibilities once celestial bodies have been reached by adding more interesting scientific endeavors and...

item.title: Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning
item.description: The hit RPG returns! Remastered with stunning visuals and refined gameplay Re-Reckoning delivers intense, customizable RPG combat inside a sprawling game world.

item.title: LEGO® Batman™ 3: Beyond Gotham
item.description: The Caped Crusader joins forces with the super heroes of the DC Comics universe and blasts off to outer space to stop the evil Brainiac from destroying Earth.

item.title: LEGO® DC Super-Villains
item.description: It's good to be bad… Embark on an all-new DC/LEGO® adventure by becoming the best villain the universe has seen. Players will create and play as an all-new super-villain throughout the game, unleashing mischievous antics and wreaking havoc in an action-packed story.

item.title: LEGO® Party!
item.description: LEGO® Party! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO® and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

item.title: Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition
item.description: The Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition includes single-player base content and over 40 DLC from the highly acclaimed Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2, and Mass Effect 3 games, including promo weapons, armors, and packs — remastered and optimized for 4K Ultra HD.

item.title: Mass Effect™: Andromeda Deluxe Edition
item.description: Return to the Mass Effect universe & lead the first humans in Andromeda on a desperate search for our new home.

item.title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
item.description: The year is 3015. The battlefields are dominated by war machines known as BattleMechs. Level entire cities and decimate the enemy in your BattleMech. Follow a quest for glory and revenge. Manage an expanding mercenary company. Fight alongside your friends with a four-player PvE co-op.

item.title: Mortal Kombat 1
item.description: Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat™ Universe created by the Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat™ 1 ushers in a new era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and fatalities!

item.title: Mortal Kombat X
item.description: Experience the Next Generation of the #1 Fighting Franchise. Mortal Kombat X combines unparalleled, cinematic presentation with all new gameplay.

item.title: Mortal Kombat 11
item.description: Mortal Kombat is back and better than ever in the next evolution of the iconic franchise.

item.title: MX vs ATV Legends
item.description: Race your way to victory on bikes, ATVs and UTVs in MX vs ATV Legends! Featuring massive new open environments, plus a career mode that lets you experience all the risks and rewards of becoming a world-famous professional rider. Become an off-road racing legend in your own right! Your time is now!

item.title: Need for Speed™ Heat
item.description: Hustle by day and risk it all at night in Need for Speed™ Heat Deluxe Edition, a white-knuckle street racer, where the lines of the law fade as the sun starts to set.

item.title: Need for Speed™ Unbound
item.description: Race to the top, definitely don’t flop. Outsmart the cops, and enter weekly qualifiers for The Grand: the ultimate street race. Pack your garage with precision-tuned, custom rides, and light up the streets with your style.

item.title: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2: Deluxe Edition
item.description: Ready the Peashooters and prepare for the craziest, funniest shooter in the universe: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2.

item.title: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
item.description: The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! The original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with stunning HD graphics and packed with new secrets and content to uncover.

item.title: PlateUp!
item.description: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!

item.title: REANIMAL
item.description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

item.title: REMNANT II®
item.description: REMNANT II® pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

item.title: Remnant: From the Ashes
item.description: The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. As one of the last remnants of humanity, you must set out alone or alongside up to two other survivors to face down hordes of deadly enemies to try to carve a foothold, rebuild, and retake what was lost.

item.title: Sniper Elite 4
item.description: Discover unrivalled sniping freedom in the largest and most advanced World War 2 shooter ever built. Experience tactical third-person combat, gameplay choice and epic longshots across gigantic levels as you liberate wartime Italy from the grip of Fascism.

item.title: Sniper Elite 5
item.description: The award-winning series returns as Karl Fairburne fights to uncover Project Kraken in 1944 France. The genre-defining authentic sniping, with enhanced kill cam, has never looked or felt better as you fight across immersive maps to stop the Nazi war machine in its tracks.

item.title: Sniper Elite: Resistance
item.description: Offering unparalleled sniping mechanics, stealth and tactical third-person combat, Sniper Elite: Resistance turns the attention of the award-winning series towards a hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

item.title: Sonic & All-Stars Racing Transformed Collection
item.description: Compete across land, water and air in incredible transforming vehicles that change from cars to boats to planes mid-race.

item.title: Sonic Adventure 2
item.description: Experience two unique adventures featuring both long-time heroes and new and returning villains as they battle for the fate of the world!

item.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate
item.description: Join Sonic in the high-speed adventure of a lifetime across a colorful interstellar amusement park. Color the Universe in Sonic Colors: Ultimate!

item.title: Sonic Frontiers
item.description: Sonic Frontiers is a groundbreaking open-zone action-adventure game set on the ancient Starfall Islands. Join Sonic as he battles hordes of powerful enemies with an all-new combat system, explores the mysteries of the islands, and saves his friends!

item.title: Sonic Mania
item.description: Sonic Mania is an all-new adventure with Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles full of unique bosses, rolling 2D landscapes, and fun classic gameplay.

item.title: Sonic Mania - Encore DLC
item.description: Get the Encore DLC to experience the all-new Encore Mode, two new playable characters Mighty and Ray, and four player Competition Mode.

item.title: Sonic Origins
item.description: Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles, including 12 Game Gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind-the-scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

item.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
item.description: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

item.title: SONIC SUPERSTARS
item.description: Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands in this all-new take on classic 2D Sonic high-speed action platforming in Sonic Superstars.

item.title: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS
item.description: Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences!

item.title: SPORE™
item.description: Be the architect of your own universe with Spore, an exciting single-player adventure. From Single Cell to Galactic God, evolve your creature in a universe of your own creations.

item.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order Deluxe Edition
item.description: A galaxy-spanning adventure awaits in Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order, a 3rd person action-adventure title from Respawn. An abandoned Padawan must complete his training, develop new powerful Force abilities, and master the art of the lightsaber - all while staying one step ahead of the Empire.

item.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™
item.description: The story of Cal Kestis continues in STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™, a galaxy-spanning, third-person, action-adventure game.

item.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II
item.description: Be the hero in the ultimate STAR WARS™ battle fantasy with STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition!

item.title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings™ Game
item.description: Welcome home, Hobbit! Live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, & share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits & familiar faces awaiting your arrival in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game.

item.title: Team Sonic Racing™
item.description: Team Sonic Racing combines the best elements of arcade and fast-paced competitive style racing as you face-off with friends in intense multiplayer racing.

item.title: The Sims™ 2 Legacy Collection
item.description: The game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. In The Sims 2, you direct your Sims over a lifetime. Give them a long existence, or leave their lives in shambles. Guide their characteristics from one generation to the next.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack
item.description: Break free from the everyday with daring activities and Getaways in The Sims™ 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack*.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Businesses & Hobbies Expansion Pack
item.description: Pursue new skills and live a life of accomplishment in The Sims™ 4 Businesses & Hobbies Expansion Pack*.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Cats & Dogs
item.description: Create a variety of cats and dogs, add them to your Sims’ homes to forever change their lives, and care for neighborhood pets as a veterinarian with The Sims™ 4 Cats & Dogs*.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 City Living
item.description: Take your Sims to the city and explore everything it has to offer, from bustling action outside your door, to unique situations that come only with apartment living in The Sims™ 4 City Living.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Enchanted by Nature Expansion Pack
item.description: Live surrounded by the magic of nature in The Sims™ 4 Enchanted by Nature Expansion Pack*.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 High School Years Expansion Pack
item.description: Class is in session. Be a good (or bad) student, join after-school activities, explore aesthetics, start trends, find your identity, and make the most of being a teenager with The Sims 4 High School Years Expansion Pack.

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Seasons
item.description: Add weather to your Sims’ lives to tell new stories, enjoy seasonal activities, and celebrate heartfelt holidays with The Sims™ 4 Seasons.

item.title: The Sims™ Legacy Collection
item.description: The original game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. Create a neighborhood of Sims and guide their lives through careers and romance. Or create chaos with open-ended gameplay that lets you shape their destinies.

item.title: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
item.description: A time of untold chaos has come. Mighty forces clash behind the scenes in a struggle for power and influence. The Northern Kingdoms mobilize for war. But armies on the march are not enough to stop a bloody conspiracy...

item.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
item.description: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Before you stands a war-torn, monster-infested continent you can explore at will. Your current contract? Tracking down Ciri — the Child of Prophecy, a living weapon that can alter the shape of the world.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™
item.description: Discover an atmospheric hunting game like no other in this realistic, stunning open world – regularly updated in collaboration with the community. Immerse yourself in the single player campaign, or share the ultimate hunting experience with friends.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Silver Ridge Peaks
item.description: Whether you are tracking turkeys through the valley or lining up to shoot a mountain goat on a cliff above the cloudline, it's hard to resist taking in the grandeur of Silver Ridge Peaks.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve
item.description: Brave the beauty at the stunning Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve. Hunt among three distinct climate regions and go in pursuit of 10 new animal species.

item.title: Titan Quest II
item.description: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest II, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

item.title: Titanfall® 2
item.description: Respawn Entertainment gives you the most advanced titan technology in its new, single player campaign & multiplayer experience. Combine & conquer with new titans & pilots, deadlier weapons, & customization and progression systems that help you and your titan flow as one unstoppable killing force.

item.title: Way of the Hunter 2
item.description: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the North American wilderness and the African Savanna. Hunt and display big game like Moose, and Cape Buffalo as well as, smaller animals and birds.

item.title: Witchfire
item.description: Witchfire is a first-person dark fantasy RPG shooter in which you play as a wicked sinner turned witch hunter on his final mission to reach salvation.

item.title: Wreckfest
item.description: Wreckfest is a demolition derby themed racing game with soft-body damage modeling, sophisticated driving dynamics and in-depth vehicle upgrading, featuring both demolition derbies and more traditional track races. It’s all about fun, breakneck racing and over-the-top crashes.

item.title: Wreckfest 2
item.description: Ready for mayhem? Wreckfest is back, offering the best in full-contact racing with unrivaled destruction! Witness head-to-head battles as you tear apart rival vehicles bit by bit. Powered by the enhanced physics engine, developed by the creators of Wreckfest & FlatOut!

item.title: YOU ARE THE MONSTER
item.description: Ever wanted to be a giant monster rampaging through a city? Experience mindless chaos as you destroy all in your path, earning new abilities, new monsters and new ways to wreak havoc.

item.title: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
item.description: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this ♡♡♡♡ world with your degen otaku-posting.

item.title: Zombie Army 4: Dead War
item.description: Hitler’s hordes are back for more in this spine-chilling shooter from the makers of Sniper Elite 4! Abominable occult enemies, epic weapons and a harrowing new campaign for 1-4 players await in 1940s Europe, as you fight to save humankind from undead Armageddon!

item.title: Love n Life: Happy Student
item.description: Love n Life: Happy Student, a unique dating sim, incorporates inventory management for the first time. As a top-scoring third-year student, you are chosen to join the most prestigious college, where you’ll meet gorgeous ladies. Discover intriguing personalities and the school’s mysteries.
